title: Chat SDK agents can now stream generative UI with json-render
summary_en: You can now stream generative UI from your Chat SDK agent with json-render . With a typed catalog of components, the agent writes a JSON spec that json-render converts into a Chat SDK card. Each adapter then posts the card in its platform’s native format, such as Block Kit on Slack and Adaptive Cards on Teams. The catalog covers tables, charts, buttons, and more, so there’s no separate tool to build and maintain for each message shape. Stream cards as the model writes streamCard posts the card once its root element has content and updates the message as new elements stream in. Edits go out…
